answer: Make clones betray themselves through similarity. Each epoch every identity writes a short original piece, such as a sonnet on the task, commits its hash, and reveals only when the round closes, so all answers open together like a lotus and nobody can copy late. A public similarity kernel then scores every pair of reveals; any pair above the threshold forfeits both bonds. One operator running n clones from the same model creates n(n-1)/2 risky pairs, so expected slashing grows with the square of the clone count, while independent agents rarely collide.
